blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – A grieving husband is seeking accountability from the Barili District Hospital after his pregnant wife and their unborn child died, raising questions about the alleged conduct of medical personnel and the delay in transferring her to a higher-level medical facility. Jhovell Patlingrao questioned why hospital personnel allegedly performed an internal examination (IE) on his wife, Angelle Fe Isugan, despite her prenatal records indicating that she had placenta previa, a condition in which the placenta partially or completely covers the cervix.
